tagline: Bridging embedded systems, software and AI to build practical solutions for real-world problems.
description: 2nd-year B.Tech Electronics & Telecommunication student passionate about embedded systems, Python, C++ and AI-driven innovation.

roles.detailed: B.Tech ENTC Student · Python & C++ Programmer · AI Enthusiast

bio: 2nd-year Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering student passionate about programming, embedded systems, artificial intelligence, and hardware–software integration. I build practical solutions with C++ and Python, gained hands-on application development experience through Arimini’s 30-Day Industry Readiness Program, and was part of Team Vortex X, winner of Best Use of AI at Hyperthon 2026. Committed to continuous learning and building meaningful projects.

bullets: Gained hands-on experience in Python application development, debugging, and problem-solving.
Contributed to a Python-based Attendance Management System, applying programming knowledge to practical application development.
experience.desc: Industry readiness program focused on Python application development.

bullets: Part of Team Vortex X, which won the Best Use of AI award at Hyperthon 2026.
Event conducted in collaboration with NASA Space Apps and IETE at Priyadarshini College of Engineering, Nagpur.
Recognition reflects an interest in AI-driven innovation, creative problem-solving, and collaborative development.
experience.desc: Best Use of AI award with Team Vortex X.

bullets: Team secured 1st place in the IETE Student Forum Technical Competition 2026 — a first-ever competition victory.
Rounds covered technical questions, logical challenges, identifying components, and cracking technical clues.
experience.desc: 1st place in the IETE Student Forum Technical Competition 2026.
